name: Shōbu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shōbu town emblem in black: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing the character 菖, with stylised leaves below.
history: Flag of the former town of Shōbu in Saitama Prefecture, dissolved on 2010-03-23. The municipal emblem was adopted on 26 May 1960.

features.role: Shōbu town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing the character 菖, with stylised leaves below
